unit.why: A story quoted from the Hida's Shem ha-Gedolim about the kabbalist R. Tzemach in Damascus, who was healed after Elijah appeared to him. He is a pre-Hasidic figure.

stories.start_quote: והרב מוהר״ר צמח הנז׳ היה חולה
stories.summary_en: R. Tzemach lay sick in Damascus for about two years until Elijah appeared to him and told him to undertake to study Torah all night on the eve of every circumcision in the city; he accepted, was healed at once, kept this custom from then on, and also urged people about Sabbath observance and immersion on Friday.

tags.why: Praise of a pre-Hasidic kabbalist, copied from the Hida's Shem ha-Gedolim.
Elijah reveals himself and gives instructions.

quotes: שנגלה אליו אליהו זכור לטוב ואמר לו
שנגלה אליו אליהו זכור לטוב ואמר לו
שלח מלאכו וירפאהו וכמו רגע חזר לבריאתו
tags.why: He is miraculously healed of a long illness.

quotes: ואתרחיש ליה ניסא שלח מלאכו וירפאהו

tags.why: Vigil on the eve of the circumcision.
Night-long Torah study is the remedy and his custom.

quotes: ויתיב בשערי טבילה שיטבלו בערב כדין
tags.why: He sat at the gates of the ritual bath on Friday to urge immersion.

tags.why: He warned people about Sabbath observance on Fridays.

tags.why: The tale is framed as told by the rabbi and by eyewitnesses.
